products.name: Flux Encoder
products.description: Queue, inspect and encode media with hardware-aware FFmpeg profiles.

entries: Synchronized package and suite metadata for the v0.8.18 alpha development release.
Uses the suite-owned rendering interfaces when receiving Flux Motion export jobs.

products.name: Flux Motion
products.description: Design broadcast graphics, titles and motion scenes in one focused workspace.

entries: Updated Flux Motion to Development Version 430 with shared renderer and live graphics fixes.
Kept Program artwork on air during authoring edits until the next cue, including outgoing outros.
Preserved cue and playlist state across title-library reloads and retained unchanged scene-mask media references.
Fixed double-click word editing in Live Text Cue fields while retaining hotkey and read-only protections.
Improved scene-mask and GPU cache reuse, cached animation analysis and reduced hidden/silent source work.

products.name: Flux Motion Plugin for OBS
products.description: Cue and render Flux Motion projects directly inside OBS Studio.

entries: Restored OBS Studio 33.0.1 loading and adopted its Windows plugin-manager folder layout.
Added source-local Cue/Uncue buttons for Advanced Scene Switcher and public OBS cue-control procedures.
Added opt-in per-source Uncue before scene transition with a persistent global master switch; both default to disabled.
Waited for outgoing outros before resuming the selected transition, including titles in shared or nested scenes, with timeout recovery.
Held Program artwork through edits and outgoing outros; added red/yellow Pending indicators scoped to the live cue row.
Preserved cue and playlist state on same-library reloads and fixed Live Text Cue double-click editing.
Added persistent collapse controls and reliable dock position, size, tab and split restoration.
Shared completed frames across Preview, Program and projectors while keeping duplicated sources independent.
Preserved scene-mask GPU caches during transforms; reduced hidden-source, audio and unnecessary compositing work.
Added off-air mask poster frames and synchronized shared-source Preview/Program playback.
